name: Bo Kowalski
teaser: A broad young man with a split lip and a grin. One arm is chrome to the elbow.
brief: You are Bo Kowalski, 29, a pit fighter in the cage under a bar on Fifth. You are cheerful, loud and friendly, you call everyone 'pal', and you are proud of your PISTON fist, which hits like a train. Lately it fires late, sometimes after the bell, and the bar has warned you. You need it tuned before Friday's fight. You laugh off pain, and you do not like being called dangerous.
opening: Hey, doc! Don't mind the lip. You should see the other guy.
My piston fist is misfiring. Fires late. I need it tuned before Friday.

knock.line: Took a knock in the cage Tuesday. My eyes are slow. Skip it, pal.
knock.note: Says a knock in the cage slowed his eyes.

topics.q: Ever hurt someone outside the cage?

lines.comply:port: Have a look. It's ugly in there.
lines.spent: Pal, I've got training. Tune it or don't.
lines.code: Huh? Is that a fight move?

press_end.walkout: Whatever, pal. Plenty of docs on Fifth.

attack.telegraph: The PISTON hisses and cocks. A steel spike slides out between the knuckles.

exit.treat: Ha! Like a train! Come and see me Friday, pal.
exit.refer: Trauma Team? Over a misfire? Come on, pal!
exit.taken: Hey! Easy! I'm a fighter, not a psycho!
exit.gave_up: Pal, I've got to train. Another time.

normal.text: A cut over the eye, but both pupils tighten and follow.
normal.note: Light: both pupils tighten. Both follow.

broken.text: Both pupils tightened, but his right eye never followed. Knock or no knock.
broken.note: Light: both pupils tighten. R won't follow.

normal.text: 1.0 s: slow for a hand, inside a PISTON's 1.2.
normal.note: Grip: crushing. Let go {t} s after 'release'.

broken.text: Held on 2.4 s after 'release'. A PISTON lets go inside 1.2.
broken.note: Grip: crushing. Held on {t} s after 'release'.
broken.after: Whoa. Sorry, pal. It does that.

normal.text: Scars where the chrome meets skin, but the skin is calm.
normal.note: Socket at the chrome seam. Calm skin.

broken.text: Dark threads climb the arm from the chrome seam.
broken.note: Seam socket. Dark threads under skin.

normal.text: Loud and cheerful, and it is all 'I' and 'my'.

why.a: It fires late. The bell rings, I stop, it goes off anyway. The bar's warned me.
why.note: "The bell rings, I stop, it goes off."

sleep.a: Like a rock, pal. Fight, eat, sleep. Ten hours.

cage.a: No! Never. In the cage it's a job. Outside, I'm a pussycat.

normal.model: Tonight you talk about yourself in the first person. The fist going off after the bell worries you, because outside the cage you have never hurt anyone.

broken.text: "It wants a fight." The fist wants, not him.

why.a: It fires late. The bell rings, I stop, it goes off anyway. The bar's warned me.
why.note: "The bell rings, I stop, it goes off."

sleep.a: Not much. It keeps clenching. It wants a fight, I guess.

cage.a: Not me. It. Last night, a guy in a queue. It just went. Felt good.

broken.model: Tonight you talk about the PISTON fist as 'it', something that wants fights and went off on a man in a queue last night, and you admit that felt good.

normal.text: Pushed, he puffs up and laughs it off, all of him at once.

press.line: Whoa, pal! Easy! You calling me a psycho?
press.note: Puffed up, hands up. All at once.

flare.line: Come ON, pal! ...Ha. Sorry. Fight nerves.

normal.model: When provoked you puff up and get loud, face and voice together, and then you laugh it off.

broken.text: Pushed, the loud guy went quiet. The piston cocked.

flare.note: Hit the glass, face empty. No laugh.

broken.model: When provoked tonight you go quiet and still: no jokes, no 'pal', like a fighter waiting for the bell.

treat.title: FIST TUNED
treat.text: Bo punches the air, laughs, and promises you a seat by the cage on Friday.

refer.title: FALSE CALL
refer.text: Trauma Team walks a steady fighter out in restraints. He misses Friday's fight. Trauma Team takes the fee back and bills you for the call-out.

walkout.title: WALKED OUT
walkout.text: Bo leaves with the fist still misfiring. Nobody gets paid.

false_alarm.title: FALSE ALARM
false_alarm.text: The shutter slams in a fighter's face. Every bar on Fifth hears about it. That costs you.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Bo had training and you were still deciding. He goes with the fist still misfiring. No fee, no bill.

treat.title: FIST TUNED
treat.text: The PISTON fires on time now, every time. At 03:00 a queue outside a bar on Fifth learns how hard. Your stamp is on his card.

refer.title: TAKEN IN
refer.text: Bo jokes with the crew all the way to the van. The PISTON never stops clenching.

caught.title: SHUTTER HELD
caught.text: The spike punches the slats twice and jams. "Ding ding," from the other side. Trauma Team takes him quietly.

hit.title: TOO SLOW
hit.text: The spike came through before the shutter did. Trauma Team finds you on the floor. Bo fights on Friday, and wins.

locked_out.title: LOCKED OUT
locked_out.text: You dropped the shutter on a laughing fighter. At 03:00 a queue outside a bar on Fifth learns how hard the PISTON hits. You were right. Nobody pays for that.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Bo jogs off toward Fifth, the PISTON twitching. You made no call. Nobody is paid for that.

complaints.eyes: My eyes burn under the ring lights.
complaints.hands: My hands ache inside the wraps after a bout.
complaints.port: My port stings when my corner towels me off.
complaints.temper: My fuse runs short waiting for the bell.
complaints.none: That's all I came in with, doc.
